verification.scope: Declared Linux CI gates only; excluded checks are not verified. This does not establish publisher authentication, first GUI launch, local-model operation or complete clean-host usability.

release-tests.scope: All checks in this required gate.

release-auth.scope: Publisher authentication parser, crypto, replay and private-snapshot fixtures with ephemeral keys; production signing and installer integration are separate.

release-tag.scope: All checks in this required gate.

interface.scope: All checks in this required gate.

glib-backport.scope: Exact vendored GLib source/provenance, packaged-notice fixtures and optimized iterator regression; native package/window qualification is separate.

native-source.scope: Default non-ignored Rust suite; the exact built-project cleanup fixture is transferred to the required built-project-cleanup gate. Other explicitly optional ignored tests are excluded and recorded.
optional_checks: test live_local_acceptance_from_explicit_models ... ignored, requires explicit installed GGUF paths and a real llama-server
test live_qwen3_agent_and_gemma4_vision_from_the_ollama_store ... ignored, runs real models on this computer's GPU
test live_three_model_compare_cancels_queued_models ... ignored, requires three explicit installed GGUF paths and a real llama-server
test local_downloads::tests::catalog_matches_hugging_face ... ignored, network: downloads each model's header from huggingface.co
test local_downloads::tests::live_download_pause_resume_verify ... ignored, network: downloads a model of several GB
test voice::whisper::tests::transcribes_with_a_local_model ... ignored, needs a whisper model file

built-project-cleanup.scope: Release-profile cleanup over the actual npm-installed ui/node_modules and built ui/dist on the CI host, with entries/bytes/time reported. Full multi-GiB Cargo-cache qualification is separate.

native-behavior.scope: All checks in this required gate.

native-window.scope: Native fixture window and embedded Markdown worker under the real security policy; authenticated cloud-consent check is optional and reported separately. This is X11 source-binary evidence, not Wayland or standalone package qualification.
optional_checks: Authenticated cloud-consent check skipped: no Ready cloud row.

native-endurance.scope: 100 sequential short command tasks through the real X11/WebKit window with explicit approvals and resource/listener measurements; the shared smoke optional cloud-consent observation is reported separately. Separate from representative long-stream input latency, physical Wayland, GPU inference and release-package endurance.
optional_checks: Authenticated cloud-consent check skipped: no Ready cloud row.

managed-runtime.scope: All checks in this required gate.

packages.scope: All checks in this required gate.

clean-host-packages.scope: Both packages installed or extracted in a network-disabled Debian 13 runtime container; offline CLI status, Debian launcher/icon metadata, packaged MCP stdio initialize/tool discovery and a visible first GUI window under Xvfb. Interactive GUI tasks, physical Wayland, local inference, model downloads and installer rollback remain separate.

packaged-behavior.scope: Packaged fixture behavior on the CI build host; authenticated cloud-consent check is optional and reported separately.
optional_checks: Authenticated cloud-consent check skipped: no Ready cloud row.

installer.scope: All checks in this required gate.
